run.input_text: Deploy a containerized Python REST API on AWS ECS Fargate in eu-central-1. Traffic comes from the internet over HTTPS through an Application Load Balancer with an existing ACM certificate (pass the ARN as a variable). The containers run in private subnets across two availability zones and pull the image from Amazon ECR. The API uses a PostgreSQL database on Amazon RDS in private subnets, with automated backups and encryption at rest. Store the database password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable autoscaling between 2 and 6 tasks based on CPU usage. Send container logs to CloudWatch Logs. Expected load is about 200 requests per second at peak. Keep the monthly cost reasonable for a small company.

services.name: api-service
services.purpose: Containerized Python REST API running on AWS Fargate.

services.name: alb
services.purpose: Internet‑facing Application Load Balancer that terminates HTTPS.

services.name: rds-db
services.purpose: PostgreSQL database instance in private subnets.

services.name: cloudwatch-logs
services.purpose: Collects container logs from the ECS task.

services.name: autoscaling
services.purpose: Scales the ECS service between 2 and 6 tasks based on CPU usage.

dependencies.description: API traffic is routed through the ALB.
API connects to the PostgreSQL database.
API container logs are sent to CloudWatch Logs.
API service is auto‑scaled based on CPU metrics.

network.notes: ALB uses an existing ACM certificate (ARN passed as a variable). All resources are placed in eu-central-1 across two AZs in private subnets.
